defs.def: of the present time or recent times 现代的；当代的；近代的

ex.s: It’s one of 47 that make up the peaceful mid-20th-century modern village of Usonia.
ex.t: 它是组成Usonia这座宁静的20世纪中期现代风格村庄的47座住宅之一。

ex.s: This beautiful structure, named Glasshouse, is at the centre of a new garden that shows how the Silk Road influences English gardens even in modern times.
ex.t: 这座名为Glasshouse的美丽建筑位于一座新花园的中心，展示了丝绸之路如何在现代仍影响着英国花园。

ex.s: A review of modern paintings.
ex.t: 一篇现代绘画评论。

ex.s: They adopt modern cooking methods.
ex.t: 它们采用现代烹饪方法。

ex.s: Beijing is a city bridging the ancient and the modern.
ex.t: 北京是一座连接古代与现代的城市。

ex.s: “I don’t really mind it,” Emil Norby told Modern Farmer magazine.
ex.t: “我并不真的介意，”埃米尔·诺比告诉《现代农民》杂志。

ex.s: How to Use a Modern Public Library
ex.t: 如何使用现代公共图书馆

ex.s: They were much stronger than modern humans, but it's long been assumed that human ancestors were   10   （smart）than the Neanderthals.
ex.t: 他们（尼安德特人）比现代人类强壮得多，但长期以来人们一直认为人类祖先比尼安德特人____（更聪明）。

ex.s: If we can rediscover the values of hands-on experience and craftwork, Smith says, we can marry the best of our modern insights with the handiness of our ancestors.
ex.t: 史密斯说，如果我们能重新发现动手实践和工艺的价值，我们就能把现代见解的精华与我们祖先的灵巧结合起来。

ex.s: Wang’s works show a deep understanding of modern architecture and a good knowledge of traditions.
ex.t: 王澍的作品显示出对现代建筑的深刻理解和对传统的良好把握。

ex.s: his interest in modern art
ex.t: 他在出版方面的成功

ex.s: But it's worth remembering that the banking system that we now all live with is just that: A modern invention.
ex.t: 但值得记住的是，我们现在赖以生存的银行体系不过如此：一种现代发明。

ex.s: Bradford said that large modern theaters in the city made it impossible for the Plaza to compete.
ex.t: 布拉德福德说城里的大型现代剧院使得广场影院无法与之竞争。

ex.s: Today, local people use modern methods to maintain the terraces, and they attract lots of visitors from all over the country.
ex.t: 如今，当地人使用现代方法来维护梯田，它们吸引了来自全国各地的众多游客。

ex.s: Modern English still used the word “odyssey” to describe an epic voyage or journey.
ex.t: 现代英语仍然使用odyssey这个词来描述一次史诗般的航程或旅程。

ex.s: Unlike the original stories, it is set in modern times and features modern technologies such as computers and smart phones.
ex.t: 与最初的故事不同，它以现代为背景，以电脑和智能手机等现代技术为特色。

ex.s: A well-known bilingual writer, Lin brought the concept of humour to modern Chinese literature.
ex.t: 作为一位著名的双语作家，林语堂将幽默的概念引入到现代中国文学中。

ex.s: Pierre de Coubertin Founder of the modern Olympic Games The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not to win but to take part, just as the most important thing in life is not the triumph but the struggle.
ex.t: 皮埃尔\u00b7德\u00b7顾拜旦 现代奥林匹克运动会创始人 奥林匹克运动会最重要的不是获胜而是参与，正如人生最重要的不是凯旋而是奋斗。

ex.s: Modern technology may help to shape the rivers’ temporal frame．
ex.t: 现代技术可能有助于塑造河流的时间框架．

ex.s: If you’re looking for cleanliness and a modern hostel, look no further than Youth Station.
ex.t: 如果你想要干净现代的青旅，Youth Station是不二之选。

ex.s: Modern America was born on the road, behind a wheel.
ex.t: 现代美国诞生于公路上、方向盘后。

defs.def: new and intended to be different from traditional styles 艺术、音乐、时装等的风格

ex.s: The aesthetic assessment of modern art.
ex.t: 对现代艺术的审美评估。

ex.s: To voice his views on modern art.
ex.t: 为了表达他对现代艺术的看法。

ex.s: The menu in this beautiful colonial house includes traditional Thai cuisine combined with modern cooking methods.
ex.t: 这座美丽的殖民风格宅邸里的菜单包括传统泰国菜与现代烹饪方法的结合。

defs.def: using the latest technology, designs, materials, etc. 时新的；现代化的；最新的

ex.s: It is a modern city.
ex.t: 它是一座现代城市。

ex.s: There is a separate bedroom, a modern kitchen with a refrigerator.
ex.t: 有一个独立的卧室，还有一个带冰箱的现代厨房。

ex.s: “We can’t seem to make up our minds whether we want a modern city or a traditional one.
ex.t: 我们似乎拿不定主意，到底是想要一座现代城市还是传统城市。

defs.def: new and not always accepted by most members of society 行为、思想等的方式

ex.s: So to try to change a distinctly modern behavior, lawmakers and public health experts are reaching back to an old approach: They want to treat distracted driving like drunk driving.
ex.t: 所以，为了试图改变一种典型的现代行为，立法者和公共卫生专家正在回归一种旧方法：他们想把分心驾驶像酒驾一样对待。

chunks.cn: 一个 现代的 都市
在…里 现代的 时间
